analytics.disabled_reason: Production collection is off. GitHub Pages has no application runtime and no approved same-origin collector deployment or host/proxy logging review exists. The shipped client and Python collector now share one tested event schema; local test events are not production measurements.
enable_procedure: Deploy analytics/collector.py behind an HTTPS same-origin reverse proxy at /api/analytics/events; GitHub Pages alone cannot provide this route. No host has been provisioned by this repository.
Review hosting and proxy logs, retention and visitor-facing privacy wording. Set the collector deployment environment variables described in analytics/README.md only after approval.

Record endpoint_deployed, runtime_selected and privacy_notice_approved in data/analytics-plan.json; set collection.enabled and analytics.enabled together, with analytics.endpoint=/api/analytics/events.

Run schema and end-to-end tests, confirm daily aggregates contain no raw identifiers, and update any stale privacy claims the publishing gate reports. Keep all production counters blank until first-party reports exist.

analytics.policy_basis: Program Policies Participation Requirements 3(e) require accurate data/technology disclosures; 6(s) prohibits artificial affiliate clicks. Trusted link activations are counted without delaying navigation. Page views and a fixed active-reading bucket are aggregate on-site events; neither opens Amazon nor asserts a conversion.
